title: STORY COLLECTION: VIGILO OPEN
lines: 01 NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: VIGILO OPEN
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: 'Imagini', Materials, etc.

DETAILS: Vigilo event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain 'Imagini' from clearing all the stages except Annihilation and Extreme Mode to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments at the Cogitatio. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.
Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics - Wasteland Walker for Provence, Information Fragments, Furniture Parts, Battle Records, Recruitment Permits, Elite Materials, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Intelligence. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Intelligence.
